thread:
Lina Gomez: Heads-up, noticed a throughput + tail-latency coupling during the 03:40 UTC window. Looks like when ingestion spikes > 600rps we see 99th jump and throughput backpressure. Need short-term SLO/SLA decisions and action item owners.

Rajiv Kumar: Can you summarize numbers? Is this in the model queue or infra?

Lina Gomez: Infra-side. KV write backlog + bursty batch sizes from the feeder. Numbers: baseline throughput 800rps, during spike 1200rps; p99 latency went from 220ms -> 520ms. Error-budget impact: estimated extra 1.8% burn for the day on p99 SLO (target p99<300ms monthly).

Owen Lee: Two quick plays: throttle ingress bursts (rate limit burst window) OR temporarily relax p99 SLO to 350ms for 72h while we remediate. Which do we prefer?

Tasha (ops): Ops preference: do the SLO window first and add ingress smoothing. That avoids customer-facing throttles and gives engineers breathing room. We'll document in SLA change log.

Lina Gomez: Draft plan: 1) Temporary SLO: p99 -> 350ms for 72h (owner Tasha, apply now, auto-revert) 2) Ingress smoothing: feeder token-bucket burst cap reduce from 2k->1k over 30s (owner Owen, 24h) 3) KV-driver mitigation: disable sync-on-close for small writes (owner Rajiv, 5d) 4) Observability: add p99-by-prefix heatmap + PD rule for sustained p99>0.9 for 10m (owner Lina, 48h) 5) Recurrence automation: create watch that counts events (>=2 events in 30d) and triggers automated feeder throttling (owner Lina, 7d).

slo-bot: Suggested commit message: "temporary: bump p99 SLO to 350ms for 72h - INF-4610".

Rajiv Kumar: I'll take the driver patch. I can prototype an fsync-batching switch. ETA 4d, will open INF-4611.

Owen Lee: Opening PR for feeder smoothing. Will include canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and perf test artifacts. ETA 18h. PR: https://git.redwood/feeder/pull/982

Tasha (ops): I'll apply the SLO change and add a note on the customer SLA page. Also will make the SLO change non-breaking for metering (don't rebill).

Lina Gomez: Observability query proposal for p99 ratio (Grafana/PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{route=~"/cache/.*"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Alert: warn at >300ms sustained 5m, page if >350ms sustained 10m.

Owen Lee: Can we also add throughput SLO check? e.g., target 750rps 95% of time. If throughput drops <600rps for >10m trigger runbook.

Lina Gomez: Good call. Add 95th throughput check and a fallback runbook step to route low-priority traffic to best-effort pool. Owner: Tasha (ops) to implement routing rule, ETA 72h.

incident-bot: Created ticket INF-4610 "SLO concession: p99 temporary increase + ingress smoothing" and linked this thread.

Rajiv Kumar: Quick note on error budget: relaxing p99 to 350ms reduces immediate burn and keeps monthly burn within limit, but repeated concessions need governance. Can we add a policy requiring postmortem for every SLO concession >6h?

Tasha (ops): Agreed. I'll add governance step to the SLO-change workflow: require postmortem link and owner within 7d for any concession >6h.

Owen Lee: I'll add a synthetic probe hitting the cache write path at 30s cadence in the canary namespace. It will report both latency and write-amplification. ETA 24h.

Lina Gomez: Recurring incident detection: I'll create INF-4612 "recurrence-watch: ingestion-pressure" with a scheduled job that counts events and auto-opens mitigation if threshold reached. Owner Lina, ETA 7d.

Tasha (ops): Final: I'll post a note in #announcements after SLO change is live and update the SLA doc. Will also set auto-revert and ensure billing unaffected.

Lina Gomez: Thanks. Recap owners: Tasha (SLO change + SLA note + routing fallback, immediate/72h), Owen (feeder smoothing + probe, 18-24h), Rajiv (driver patch INF-4611, 4d), Lina (observability + recurrence ticket INF-4612, 48h/7d). We'll have a 10m check-in at 15:30 UTC to confirm SLO applied and PRs linked. Close when INF tickets and PRs are referenced.

Owen Lee: :thumbsup:

Rajiv Kumar: On it.

Tasha (ops): Posting announcement now.
